run_two_sample_proportion_detector: run a two sample proportion interval detector on time series data to find A/B test anomalies
run_two_sample_count_detector: run a two sample count interval detector on Poisson-distributed time series data to detect anomalies
run_one_sample_proportion_detector: run a one sample proportion interval detector on single time series data to detect anomalies
run_two_sided_detector: run a two-sided interval detector to detect both upper and lower anomalies in A/B test data
run_arrival_time_detector: run a two sample arrival time interval detector on Gamma-distributed time series data to detect anomalies
